ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% of the visible ventral surface area consists of high-intensity pixels (white/light-gray) with low-intensity pixels (black/dark-gray) restricted to the perimeter and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region occupying the central lobes. Low-intensity (dark) contiguous bands are mapped to the entire trailing edge and both distal fluke tips. A dark, irregular geometric region extends from the peduncle junction toward the fluke center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression with an approximate 90-degree internal angle; depth is roughly 10% of the vertical lobe height at that coordinate.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed across the entire trailing edge boundary, creating a jagged interface with the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Slightly convex curve fitted from the median notch to the outer tips, with a sharp downward-sloping posterior angle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A singular, localized low-intensity (dark) pixel cluster is visible centrally, positioned approximately 50 pixels below the apex of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: The transition boundary at the fluke base/peduncle displays a unique, asymmetric dark-to-light jagged interface.
